description: This header file declares functions and structures related to converting object files between different hash algorithms in a version control system (likely Git). It includes function prototypes for converting object IDs and entire object files, and references other core structures like repository, object_id, and git_hash_algo.

methods.name: repo_oid_to_algop
methods.description: Converts an object ID within a repository from one hash algorithm to another.

methods.name: convert_object_file
methods.description: Converts an object file from one hash algorithm to another, returning success or failure.
